CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   D. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Skipping all moral lessons
